segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we have a very painful lesson for you.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们要给你上一堂非常痛苦的课。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we're going to go to one of the worst places for me.
segments.zh: 今天我们要去对我来说最糟糕的地方之一。

segments.en: We're going to go to the dentist.
segments.zh: 我们要去看牙医。

segments.en: Okay, so the person in this dialogue has a pain in their mouth, in the tooth area.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这个对话中的人嘴里有疼痛感，在牙区。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to this dialogue and when we come back, we'll be talking a little bit more about it.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听这个对话，当我们回来时，我们会更多地谈论它。

segments.en: What seems to be the problem?
segments.zh: 请问有什么问题？

segments.en: I have a really bad toothache.
segments.zh: 我的牙痛真的很严重。

segments.en: My cheek is swollen and I can't eat anything.
segments.zh: 我的脸颊肿了，我什么都不能吃。

segments.en: Let's have a look.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。

segments.en: This doesn't look too good.
segments.zh: 这看起来不太好。

segments.en: I think we may have to pull out your wisdom tooth.
segments.zh: 我想我们可能不得不拔出你的智齿。

segments.en: It's pressing against your molars and that's one of the reasons you're experiencing so much pain.
segments.zh: 它压在你的臼齿上，这就是你经历如此多痛苦的原因之一。

segments.en: When you pull my tooth, will you also have to extract the nerve and the root?
segments.zh: 当你拔掉我的牙齿时，你是否也必须拔出神经和根部？

segments.en: First we will take some x-rays and see what we're dealing with.
segments.zh: 首先，我们将拍摄一些 X 光片，看看我们正在处理什么。

segments.en: I also noticed a small cavity up front here, so you are going to need a filling.
segments.zh: 我还发现前面这里有一小处蛀牙，也需要补一下。

segments.en: I guess that's what I get for not flossing or brushing my teeth three times a day.
segments.zh: 我想，这就是我不用牙线、也没有每天刷三次牙的后果吧。

segments.en: It could be that or maybe you are eating too many sweets.
segments.zh: 可能是那个，或者你吃的糖果太多了。

segments.en: In any case, I'll administer an anesthetic and you won't feel a thing.
segments.zh: 无论如何，我会使用麻醉剂，你不会有任何感觉。

segments.en: Alright we're back and obviously we're going to take a look at a lot of vocab related to going to the dentist and experiencing a little bit of pain.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，显然我们会看看很多与去看牙医和经历一点疼痛有关的词汇。

segments.en: So let's take a look at that in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们在语言要点中看看。

segments.en: First up in Language Takeaway today we have the root of the problem.
segments.zh: 首先在语言要点中，我们有问题的根源。

segments.en: It's a toothache.
segments.zh: 是牙痛。

segments.en: That's right, we have a really bad toothache.
segments.zh: 没错，我们的牙痛非常严重。

segments.en: Okay well ache means pain or soreness and tooth is your tooth.
segments.zh: 好吧，疼痛意味着疼痛或酸痛，牙齿是你的牙齿。

segments.en: So I could say, oh gosh I have a really bad toothache.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说，哦，天哪，我的牙痛非常严重。

segments.en: That's right, that means your tooth or your teeth hurt.
segments.zh: 没错，这意味着你的牙齿疼。

segments.en: And basically you can combine it like a stomachache or headache.
segments.zh: 基本上你可以像胃痛或头痛一样组合它。

segments.en: Backache.
segments.zh: 背痛。

segments.en: Backache.
segments.zh: 背痛。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So usually when you have a toothache, you experience different symptoms, different things happen to you.
segments.zh: 所以通常当你牙痛时，你会出现不同的症状，不同的事情发生在你身上。

segments.en: What's one of these things Marco?
segments.zh: 马可，其中一个是哪种情况？

segments.en: Well in this case the girl had a swollen cheek.
segments.zh: 好吧，在这种情况下，女孩的脸颊肿了。

segments.en: Her cheek is swollen.
segments.zh: 她的脸颊肿了。

segments.en: So the cheek is the side of the face.
segments.zh: 所以脸颊是脸的一面。

segments.en: It's usually where it's a little bit pink and when your cheek is swollen, it looks puffy.
segments.zh: 它通常是有点粉红色的地方，当你的脸颊肿胀时，它看起来很浮肿。

segments.en: It looks bigger than normal.
segments.zh: 它看起来比平时大。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So for example sometimes you fall and you hurt your finger and it'll get fat and it'll get puffy as you say.
segments.zh: 例如，有时你摔倒了，你的手指受伤了，它会变胖，而且会像你说的那样变得浮肿。

segments.en: It's swollen.
segments.zh: 它肿了。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So anything can be swollen really.
segments.zh: 所以任何东西都可以肿胀。

segments.en: When you hit your toe on something hard and your toe later gets bigger, it's swollen.
segments.zh: 当你的脚趾碰到一些硬的东西，你的脚趾后来变大时，它会肿胀。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So obviously her cheek is swollen and she has a toothache because apparently her wisdom teeth or her wisdom tooth is coming out.
segments.zh: 所以很明显她的脸颊肿了，她有牙痛，因为显然她的智齿或智齿要长出来了。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So wisdom teeth are special teeth.
segments.zh: 所以智齿是特殊的牙齿。

segments.en: I don't know if they actually have anything to do with wisdom which means being smart.
segments.zh: 我不知道它们是否真的跟智慧有任何关系，也就是聪明。

segments.en: To be wise.
segments.zh: 要聪明。

segments.en: Wise.
segments.zh: 明智的。

segments.en: But wisdom teeth are those four teeth in the very, very, very back of your mouth.
segments.zh: 但是智齿是你嘴巴后面的那四颗牙齿。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So these are the last teeth that come in or the last teeth that grow in your mouth.
segments.zh: 所以这些是最后一颗进来的牙齿或你嘴里长出来的最后一颗牙齿。

segments.en: So I think usually you're 18 or 20 when they come in.
segments.zh: 所以我想它们通常是在你 18 或 20 岁时长出来的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: A lot of people experience these when they're older.
segments.zh: 很多人在年长时都会经历这些。

segments.en: Maybe that's why they call them wisdom teeth because you're older and you're wiser.
segments.zh: 也许这就是人们把它们叫做智齿的原因，因为你年纪更大，也更明智了。

segments.en: I had them when I was about 14, 13.
segments.zh: 我大概十三四岁就长出来了。

segments.en: I was very young.
segments.zh: 我很年轻。

segments.en: But these come in the very back.
segments.zh: 但这些都在后面。

segments.en: They're the furthest away from your lips.
segments.zh: 它们是离你嘴唇最远的地方。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So when they come in, sometimes there's not enough space and so they start to press against the other teeth in your mouth, specifically against your molars.
segments.zh: 所以当它们进来时，有时没有足够的空间，所以它们开始压在你嘴里的其他牙齿上，特别是靠在你的臼齿上。

segments.en: So molars are other teeth.
segments.zh: 所以臼齿是其他牙齿。

segments.en: These are also in the back of your mouth.
segments.zh: 这些也在你的嘴巴后面。

segments.en: You can tell which ones are molars I believe because they're flat on top.
segments.zh: 你可以分辨出哪些是臼齿，因为它们是平的。

segments.en: They look like a little square.
segments.zh: 它们看起来像一个小方形。

segments.en: Those are the ones that you use to chew your food with mostly.
segments.zh: 这些主要就是用来咀嚼食物的牙齿。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: They're not pointy like your front teeth.
segments.zh: 它们不像你的门牙那样尖尖。

segments.en: And so molars are in the back of your mouth.
segments.zh: 所以臼齿在你的嘴巴后面。

segments.en: Wisdom teeth are in the very back of your mouth.
segments.zh: 智齿长在你嘴巴的最后面。

segments.en: And molars can be very sore when the wisdom teeth push against them.
segments.zh: 当智齿顶到臼齿时，臼齿会非常酸痛。

segments.en: And so in this case, you will have to take your teeth out or the dentist will take your teeth out.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，你必须拔掉你的牙齿，否则牙医会拔掉你的牙齿。

segments.en: But what's something we say when we talk about taking the whole tooth out?
segments.zh: 但是，当我们谈论将整颗牙齿取出时，我们会说什么？

segments.en: Well, in this case, he's going to extract the tooth, but also he's going to extract the nerve and the root.
segments.zh: 好吧，在这种情况下，他要拔掉牙齿，但他也要拔出神经和根部。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So nerves are parts of our bodies.
segments.zh: 所以神经是我们身体的一部分。

segments.en: We can't see them, but they help us feel things.
segments.zh: 我们看不到它们，但它们帮助我们感受事物。

segments.en: So maybe when someone hits me, the nerves in my arm, they tell my brain that it hurts.
segments.zh: 所以也许有人打我的手臂时，手臂上的神经会告诉我的大脑它很痛。

segments.en: Well, we also have nerves in our teeth and that's what we're talking about here.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们的牙齿也有神经，这就是我们在这里谈论的。

segments.en: But what's this other thing?
segments.zh: 但这是另一回事吗？

segments.en: You talked about the nerve and the root.
segments.zh: 你谈到了神经和根。

segments.en: It's very similar to a plant, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，它与植物非常相似。

segments.en: You consider that your teeth are like plants and they have little roots that go into your gums.
segments.zh: 你认为你的牙齿像植物一样，它们有扎进牙龈里的小根。

segments.en: And this is how basically you get teeth stay alive.
segments.zh: 这就是你让牙齿保持活力的方式。

segments.en: They are fed basically by your body.
segments.zh: 它们基本上是由你的身体喂养的。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So root, like with a tree or a plant, is the very bottom of something.
segments.zh: 所以根，就像一棵树或一棵植物一样，是某物的最底层。

segments.en: And in this case, to extract means to take out or to take away.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，提取意味着取出或带走。

segments.en: So the dentist will have to extract the root and the nerve.
segments.zh: 所以牙医将不得不提取根部和神经。

segments.en: So that sounds pretty painful.
segments.zh: 所以这听起来很痛苦。

segments.en: It's painful, but they have to do it, right?
segments.zh: 这很痛苦，但他们必须这样做，对吧？

segments.en: So when the dentist has to extract the tooth, in this case, the nerve and the root and everything, in order for you not to feel it, he gives you special drugs.
segments.zh: 所以当牙医不得不拔掉牙齿时，在这种情况下，神经和根部和一切，为了让你没有感觉，他会给你特殊的药物。

segments.en: What are these drugs called?
segments.zh: 这些药物叫什么？

segments.en: These are called anesthetics.
segments.zh: 这些被称为麻醉剂。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So most people, when they are having major surgery, they get anesthetics so that they can't feel anything.
segments.zh: 所以大多数人，当他们接受大手术时，他们会接受麻醉剂，这样他们就感觉不到任何东西。

segments.en: Remember, we were just talking about nerves.
segments.zh: 记住，我们只是在谈论神经。

segments.en: Well, anesthetics make it so that you can't feel things through your nerves.
segments.zh: 好吧，麻醉剂使您无法通过神经感受到事物。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So obviously you don't want to feel the pain when somebody's pulling that tooth out of your mouth.
segments.zh: 所以很明显，当有人从你的嘴里拔出那颗牙齿时，你不想感到疼痛。

segments.en: So you get an anesthetic and then you don't really feel anything.
segments.zh: 所以你得到了麻醉剂，然后你真的没有任何感觉。

segments.en: You kind of feel something, but you don't really feel pain.
segments.zh: 你有一种感觉，但你并没有真正感到痛苦。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So anesthetic basically makes you numb.
segments.zh: 所以麻醉剂基本上会让你麻木。

segments.en: Numb.
segments.zh: 麻木。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: That's the word, numb.
segments.zh: 这就是这个词，麻木。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we've taken a look at a lot of vocab, molars, wisdom teeth, etc.
segments.zh: 所以我们看了很多词汇，臼齿、智齿等等。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back in a bit with Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不再听一次对话，稍后回来进入流利表达。

segments.en: What seems to be the problem?
segments.zh: 请问有什么问题？

segments.en: I have a really bad toothache.
segments.zh: 我的牙痛真的很严重。

segments.en: My cheek is swollen and I can't eat anything.
segments.zh: 我的脸颊肿了，我什么都不能吃。

segments.en: Let's have a look.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。

segments.en: Hmm, this doesn't look too good.
segments.zh: 嗯，这看起来不太好。

segments.en: I think we may have to pull out your wisdom tooth.
segments.zh: 我想我们可能不得不拔出你的智齿。

segments.en: It's pressing against your molars and that's one of the reasons you're experiencing so much pain.
segments.zh: 它压在你的臼齿上，这就是你经历如此多痛苦的原因之一。

segments.en: When you pull my tooth, will you also have to extract the nerve and the root?
segments.zh: 当你拔掉我的牙齿时，你是否也必须拔出神经和根部？

segments.en: First we will take some x-rays and see what we're dealing with.
segments.zh: 首先，我们将拍摄一些 X 光片，看看我们正在处理什么。

segments.en: I also noticed a small cavity up front here.
segments.zh: 我还注意到前面这里有一小处蛀牙。

segments.en: So you are going to need a filling.
segments.zh: 所以你需要补牙。

segments.en: I guess that's what I get for not flossing or brushing my teeth three times a day.
segments.zh: 我想，这就是我不用牙线、也没有每天刷三次牙的后果吧。

segments.en: It could be that.
segments.zh: 可能是这样。

segments.en: Or maybe you are eating too many sweets.
segments.zh: 或者你吃的甜点太多了。

segments.en: In any case, I'll administer an anesthetic and you won't feel a thing.
segments.zh: 无论如何，我会使用麻醉剂，你不会有任何感觉。

segments.en: Alright, so the topic of today's lesson is toothache but it's also basically about learning that you will have to have your tooth taken out.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以今天课程的主题是牙痛，但它基本上也是关于学习你必须拔牙的。

segments.en: So to say this we say, to pull out a tooth.
segments.zh: 这么说，我们说，拔掉一颗牙齿。

segments.en: Okay, so that's what the dentist said.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是牙医说的。

segments.en: I think we may have to pull out your wisdom tooth.
segments.zh: 我想我们可能不得不拔出你的智齿。

segments.en: Not good news.
segments.zh: 不是好消息。

segments.en: Okay, so to pull out means to extract.
segments.zh: 好的，所以拔出意味着提取。

segments.en: So just remember here this is a phrase that has pull out.
segments.zh: 所以请记住，这是一个含有 pull out 的短语。

segments.en: Out would be the preposition here.
segments.zh: out 将是这里的介词。

segments.en: We wouldn't say pull off or pull at.
segments.zh: 我们不会说 pull off 或 pull at。

segments.en: We'd say pull out.
segments.zh: 我们会说 pull out。

segments.en: Like for example, you can pull out a hair or your hair.
segments.zh: 例如，您可以拔出头发或头发。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay, so we're pulling out the wisdom tooth and the dentist first wants to take some x-rays to see what we're dealing with.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们正在拔智齿，牙医首先想拍一些 X 光片，看看我们正在处理什么。

segments.en: Okay, so to deal with something means to work on it or to have something to do with.
segments.zh: 好的，所以处理某事意味着处理它或与之有关系。

segments.en: And so in this case the dentist wants to know, is this serious?
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，牙医想知道，这很严重吗？

segments.en: What are we dealing with here?
segments.zh: 我们在这里处理什么？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So he's trying to judge the situation.
segments.zh: 所以他在努力判断情况。

segments.en: So maybe what would be another scenario or another situation where you would say, I have to see what we're dealing with.
segments.zh: 所以也许你会说另一种情况或另一种情况，我必须看看我们正在处理什么。

segments.en: Well, in the case of the weather and the newsmen who report about the weather, maybe they see that a storm is coming but they have to look at the radars and the computer screens to see what they're dealing with.
segments.zh: 好吧，就天气和报道天气的新闻记者而言，也许他们看到暴风雨即将来临，但他们必须查看雷达和电脑屏幕才能查看他们正在处理的事情。

segments.en: Is it a serious storm or is it a very weak storm?
segments.zh: 这是一场严重的风暴还是一场非常微弱的风暴？

segments.en: They have to evaluate.
segments.zh: 他们必须评估。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And so we're going to see what we're dealing with.
segments.zh: 所以我们将看看我们正在处理什么。

segments.en: And then the girl I think knows that she hasn't really taken good care of her teeth.
segments.zh: 然后我想的那个女孩知道她并没有真正照顾好自己的牙齿。

segments.en: And so she says, I guess that's what I get for not flossing or brushing my teeth.
segments.zh: 所以她说，我想这就是我不使用牙线或刷牙而得到的。

segments.en: So that's what you get or that's what I get.
segments.zh: 所以这就是你得到的，或者这就是我得到的。

segments.en: Where the pronoun changes, I, you, he, that's what I get for not taking care of myself.
segments.zh: 代词会变化，我、你、他——这就是我不照顾自己而得到的。

segments.en: This means it's my fault.
segments.zh: 这意味着这是我的错。

segments.en: I deserved it.
segments.zh: 我应得的。

segments.en: I deserve this thing.
segments.zh: 我配得上这件事。

segments.en: So I could say, Marco, that's what you get for not doing your homework.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说，马可，这就是你不做功课得到的。

segments.en: You got a bad grade on your test.
segments.zh: 你的考试成绩不好。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's basically a way of saying, that's what you deserve.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上是一种说法，这是你应得的。

segments.en: That's the consequence for your actions.
segments.zh: 这就是你的行为的后果。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And what about our last phrase?
segments.zh: 最后一个短语是什么呢？

segments.en: This is something that I hate to hear from doctors and dentists because usually it's a lie.
segments.zh: 这是我讨厌从医生和牙医那里听到的，因为通常这是一个谎言。

segments.en: A dentist will say before he gives you a shot or before he takes your tooth out, you won't feel a thing.
segments.zh: 牙医会说，在他给你一针或拔牙之前，你不会有任何感觉。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So he's basically saying you're not going to feel any pain.
segments.zh: 所以他基本上是在说你不会感到任何痛苦。

segments.en: But why do we say you won't feel a thing instead of you won't feel anything?
segments.zh: 但是为什么我们说你 won't feel a thing，而不是 you won't feel anything？

segments.en: Just a set phrase.
segments.zh: 只是一个固定的短语。

segments.en: It's something we say, I would remember it like this because it's more likely to be said in this way.
segments.zh: 这是我们说的，我会这样记住它，因为它更有可能以这种方式说出来。

segments.en: You won't feel a thing.
segments.zh: 你不会有任何感觉。

segments.en: I think it basically means not even one little thing, you're not going to feel that.
segments.zh: 我认为这基本上意味着即使是一件小事，你也不会有这种感觉。

segments.en: So for example, I'm about to fix someone's back, you know, when you have to pull them and make their back feel better.
segments.zh: 例如，我要修复某人的背部，您知道，当您必须拉动他们并让他们的背部感觉更好时。

segments.en: I say, you won't feel a thing.
segments.zh: 我说，你不会有任何感觉。

segments.en: You fix their back.
segments.zh: 你修复他们的背部。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So you won't feel a thing or you won't feel anything.
segments.zh: 所以 you won't feel a thing，或者 you won't feel anything。

segments.en: Both are correct, but I think it's more common to hear you won't feel a thing.
segments.zh: 两者都是正确的，但我认为听到你不会有任何感觉更常见。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So why don't we go back?
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不回去呢？

segments.en: Let's take one last look at our dialogue and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 让我们最后看一下我们的对话，我们会回来的。

segments.en: What seems to be the problem?
segments.zh: 请问有什么问题？

segments.en: I have a really bad toothache.
segments.zh: 我的牙痛真的很严重。

segments.en: My cheek is swollen and I can't eat anything.
segments.zh: 我的脸颊肿了，我什么都不能吃。

segments.en: Let's have a look.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。

segments.en: Hmm.
segments.zh: 嗯。

segments.en: This doesn't look too good.
segments.zh: 这看起来不太好。

segments.en: I think we may have to pull out your wisdom tooth.
segments.zh: 我想我们可能不得不拔出你的智齿。

segments.en: It's pressing against your molars and that's one of the reasons you're experiencing so much pain.
segments.zh: 它压在你的臼齿上，这就是你经历如此多痛苦的原因之一。

segments.en: When you pull my tooth, will you also have to extract the nerve and the root?
segments.zh: 当你拔掉我的牙齿时，你是否也必须拔出神经和根部？

segments.en: First we will take some x-rays and see what we're dealing with.
segments.zh: 首先，我们将拍摄一些 X 光片，看看我们正在处理什么。

segments.en: I also noticed a small cavity up front here, so you are going to need a filling.
segments.zh: 我还发现前面这里有一小处蛀牙，也需要补一下。

segments.en: I guess that's what I get for not flossing or brushing my teeth three times a day.
segments.zh: 我想，这就是我不用牙线、也没有每天刷三次牙的后果吧。

segments.en: It could be that.
segments.zh: 可能是这样。

segments.en: Or maybe you are eating too many sweets.
segments.zh: 或者你吃的甜点太多了。

segments.en: In any case, I'll administer an anesthetic and you won't feel a thing.
segments.zh: 无论如何，我会使用麻醉剂，你不会有任何感觉。

segments.en: All right so talking about dentists and talking about wisdom teeth, you say that you still have all four wisdom teeth.
segments.zh: 好吧，谈论牙医和谈论智齿，你说你仍然有四颗智齿。

segments.en: I do.
segments.zh: 是的，我四颗都还在。

segments.en: They're all still back there.
segments.zh: 它们都还在那儿。

segments.en: So you didn't need to have them taken out or pulled?
segments.zh: 所以你不需要把它们拿出来或拉出来？

segments.en: No, as my dentist likes to say, I have a big mouth.
segments.zh: 不，正如我的牙医喜欢说的那样，我有一张大嘴巴。

segments.en: Which in English has two meanings.
segments.zh: 在英语中有两个含义。

segments.en: A big mouth is not just a large mouth, but also it means you like to talk a lot.
segments.zh: 大嘴不仅仅是一张大嘴，它也意味着你喜欢说很多话。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, but did you ever have braces for example when you were a kid?
segments.zh: 所以，但是你小时候有过牙套吗？

segments.en: Oh yes.
segments.zh: 哦，是的。

segments.en: Oh you had braces.
segments.zh: 哦，你有牙套。

segments.en: I had a retainer, which is a device that you, it looks like a line across your teeth and you put it in usually at night, but sometimes during the day and it makes some space in your mouth.
segments.zh: 我有一个固定器，那是一种装置，看起来像横跨你牙齿的一条线，你通常在晚上戴上它，但有时白天也戴，它会在你嘴里腾出一些空间。

segments.en: But I also had braces after that.
segments.zh: 但在那之后我也有牙套。

segments.en: I hated braces.
segments.zh: 我讨厌牙套。

segments.en: I had them for two years.
segments.zh: 我戴了两年。

segments.en: Why did you hate braces?
segments.zh: 你为什么讨厌牙套？

segments.en: Because they're uncomfortable.
segments.zh: 因为它们不舒服。

segments.en: Well, they don't look very good, especially when you're a 13 year old girl and you want to look cute and you have this big metal thing in your mouth.
segments.zh: 嗯，它们看起来不太好，尤其是当你是一个 13 岁的女孩并且你想看起来很可爱并且你嘴里有这种大金属的东西时。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Did you have braces?
segments.zh: 你有牙套吗？

segments.en: No, no, I never had braces.
segments.zh: 不，不，我从来没有戴过牙套。

segments.en: Actually it was kind of for a while, I think a lot of people thought it was cool to have braces.
segments.zh: 实际上有一段时间，我想很多人认为戴牙套很酷。

segments.en: I did not grow up where you grew up.
segments.zh: 我不是在你长大的地方长大的。

segments.en: It was not cool where I grew up.
segments.zh: 我长大的地方并不酷。

segments.en: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我不知道。

segments.en: I think, or it gets to a point where in certain parts, I guess my school was filled with kids that had braces.
segments.zh: 我想，或者到了某些地方，我猜我的学校里到处都是戴着牙套的孩子。

segments.en: So I guess everyone just had really bad teeth.
segments.zh: 所以我想每个人的牙齿都很糟糕。

segments.en: So obviously the people that didn't have braces kind of were left aside.
segments.zh: 很明显，没有牙套的人被抛在一边。

segments.en: So you're like, oh, I want braces.
segments.zh: 所以你就像，哦，我想要牙套。

segments.en: I want to be part of the group.
segments.zh: 我想成为小组的一员。

segments.en: I know sometimes I wish I had glasses, because everyone I know has glasses.
segments.zh: 我知道有时我希望我有眼镜，因为我认识的每个人都有眼镜。

segments.en: Really?
segments.zh: 真的吗？

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: If you have good vision though.
segments.zh: 如果你有良好的视力。

segments.en: Yeah, it sucks to be perfect, right?
segments.zh: 是的，完美是很糟糕的，对吧？

segments.en: Well, this is a really interesting topic and going to the dentist is always complicated.
segments.zh: 嗯，这是一个非常有趣的话题，去看牙医总是很复杂。

segments.en: Maybe some of our listeners are dentists themselves or they have some stories that they can share with us.
segments.zh: 也许我们的一些听众是牙医本身，或者他们有一些故事可以与我们分享。

segments.en: Please let us know what you're thinking and share your dentist stories with us on EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 请让我们知道您在想什么，并在 Englishpod.com 上与我们分享您的牙医故事。

segments.en: We'll be waiting for you there.
segments.zh: 我们会在那里等你。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys then.
segments.zh: 到时候我们会见到你们的。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
